name: Verificar Status da Conta
description: Efetua login no Ikariam e coleta o status completo da conta: cidades, recursos, ouro, militar.
description_en: Logs into Ikariam and collects full account status: cities, resources, gold, military.

name: Descobrir Personagens
description: Autentica no lobby Gameforge e lista todos os personagens/contas disponíveis com seus lobby_account_index.
description_en: Authenticates with Gameforge lobby and lists all available characters/accounts with their lobby_account_index values.
